from pyspark.sql.functions import *
from pyspark.sql.types import *


bronze_path = 'abfss://credit-card@retailsalesgb.dfs.core.windows.net/bronze/'
silver_path = 'abfss://credit-card@retailsalesgb.dfs.core.windows.net/silver/'
gold_path = 'abfss://credit-card@retailsalesgb.dfs.core.windows.net/gold/'


password = mssparkutils.credentials.getSecret(
    "CC-KeyVault-SQL",
    "SQLPasswordCC"
)
username = mssparkutils.credentials.getSecret(
    "CC-KeyVault-SQL",
    "UserNameSQL"
)

Schema Enforcement for Transactions table to be read from Bronze Layer
| Feature   | Schema Enforcement    | Schema Evolution               |
| --------- | --------------------- | ------------------------------ |
| Purpose   | Protect data quality  | Allow controlled changes       |
| Nature    | Strict                | Flexible                       |
| Prevents  | Invalid writes        | Pipeline breaks during changes |
| Best For  | Stable curated layers | Dynamic ingestion layers       |
| Common In | Silver/Gold           | Bronze/raw ingestion           |

transactions_schema = StructType([
    StructField("transaction_id", StringType(), False),
    StructField("card_id", StringType(), True),
    StructField("customer_id", StringType(), True),
    StructField("transaction_date", StringType(), True),
    StructField("transaction_time", StringType(), True),
    StructField("transaction_year", IntegerType(), True),
    StructField("transaction_month", IntegerType(), True),
    StructField("transaction_day", IntegerType(), True),
    StructField("transaction_type", StringType(), True),
    StructField("channel", StringType(), True),
    StructField("merchant_name", StringType(), True),
    StructField("merchant_category_code", IntegerType(), True),
    StructField("merchant_category_name", StringType(), True),
    StructField("merchant_city", StringType(), True),
    StructField("merchant_country", StringType(), True),
    StructField("amount_gbp", DoubleType(), True),
    StructField("currency", StringType(), True),
    StructField("is_foreign_transaction", BooleanType(), True),
    StructField("fx_rate", DoubleType(), True),
    StructField("transaction_status", StringType(), True),
    StructField("decline_reason", StringType(), True),
    StructField("is_recurring", BooleanType(), True),
    StructField("installment_plan", BooleanType(), True),
    StructField("cashback_gbp", DoubleType(), True),
    StructField("rewards_earned", IntegerType(), True),
    StructField("authorization_code", StringType(), True)

cust_cleaned = (
    df_customer
    .dropDuplicates(["customer_id"])
    .withColumn("email", lower(trim(col("email"))))
    .withColumn("first_name", initcap(trim(col("first_name"))))
    .withColumn("last_name", initcap(trim(col("last_name"))))
    .withColumn("date_of_birth", to_date(col("date_of_birth")))
    .withColumn("customer_since", to_date(col("customer_since")))
    .filter(col("credit_score") > 0)

trans_transformed = (
    trans_cleaned
    .withColumn(
        "transaction_category",
        when(col("amount_gbp") >= 1000, "High Value")
        .when(col("amount_gbp") >= 500, "Medium Value")
        .otherwise("Low Value")
    )
    .withColumn(
        "is_declined",
        when(col("transaction_status") == "Declined", 1).otherwise(0)
    )

cust_transformed = cust_cleaned.withColumn(
    "customer_age",
    floor(datediff(current_date(), col("date_of_birth")) / 365)
)


scd2_source = (
    cust_transformed
    .withColumn("start_date", current_date())
    .withColumn("end_date", lit(None).cast("date"))
    .withColumn("is_current", lit(True))

df_enriched = silver_trans.join(silver_cust, on=["customer_id"], how="left")
display(df_enriched)
df_enriched.explain(True)
df_enriched = df_enriched.drop("card_id")
